name: led_smd
title: A single-colour SMD LED
notes: Any one-colour LED of a board, as 0603 or 0805. It is here for its price by the piece: what an LED of a board that nobody asked for weighs.

lcsc.source: C2286, Hubei KENTO KT-0603R, red: search results of lcsc.com gave 0.0031 to 0.0059 for 100 to 100000 pieces; the high end is taken for the least quantity and the low for the largest, as the tiers of LCSC go down.
